What is MS40?

Mitochondrial-derived peptide profile for metabolic homeostasis and energy research. The LPPEPTIDE knowledge record describes MOTS-C as a 16-amino-acid mitochondrial-derived peptide encoded in the mtDNA 12S rRNA region, associated with AMPK activation, metabolic homeostasis, exercise-response signals, glucose metabolism, and energy-balance research. MOTS-C 40mg is mapped to LPPeptide SKU MS40. Current storefront values use our product data: 40mg x 10 vials /box, $210.00 USD per box. LPPeptide reference specs: 10mg x 10 vials / 15mg x 10 vials / 20mg x 10 vials / 40mg x 10 vials.

Research context

Dosing & Protocol

LPPeptide handling reference

LPPEPTIDE knowledge source: add 3.0 mL bacteriostatic water for about 16.7 mg/mL. Reference range is once daily 500-1500 mcg, starting around 500 mcg and adjusting gradually. At this concentration, 1 U is about 167 mcg.

LPPEPTIDE preparation pattern: use sterile technique, add diluent slowly down the vial wall, avoid foaming, roll gently until dissolved, label the preparation date, refrigerate at 2-8 deg C, and protect from light.

Preparation

MOTS-C 40mg ships as Lyophilized powder. Reconstitution note: LPPEPTIDE knowledge source: add 3.0 mL bacteriostatic water for about 16.7 mg/mL. Reference range is once daily 500-1500 mcg, starting around 500 mcg and adjusting gradually. At this concentration, 1 U is about 167 mcg.. Record the final concentration and preparation date in the study log.

Storage

Lyophilized: -20 deg C, dry and dark with desiccant. Reconstituted: 2-8 deg C and use within about 2-4 weeks for best potency.. Follow the most current lot-specific handling record whenever it is available.
